tasks.title: Bind the incoming documentation source and topic census
tasks.goal: Preserve the separately authored documentation as an exact input before planning its product-driven update.
steps: Dispatch only after NEXT-PREVIEW-DOCS-INPUT provides the exact repository, commit or retained overlay, source root, build entrypoint and generated-source inventory, relation to the captured DP1 product, and a bounded writer scope. The owner will supply this input; do not inspect or adopt another live worker directory by inference.

Resolve and retain the exact incoming documentation capture and, where the documentation already changed since its DP1-related base, both the base and current authored state. Record uncertainties about source/product correspondence instead of calling newer documentation an exact DP1 baseline.

Create documentation-map.json entries with stable topic IDs, authored page/source locations, generated output origins, mapped capability/format/change IDs, audience/workflow, product claims and build/example checks. Inventory new-topic requirements even when no current page exists.

Record the actual build toolchain and non-writing discovery results permitted by the input binding. Preserve existing worker-authored content and identify generated pages that must be regenerated from source later.

Bind a future exact update perimeter inside docs/** and the permanent release homes. If supplied sources live in another repository or outside that envelope, root refines the task packet and isolation/binding explicitly before any write; missing input blocks this lane only.
positive_cases: A separately authored document set is preserved with its exact source history and relation to DP1.
A generated reference page maps to its authored generator/schema source.
An unrepresented new capability creates a pending topic rather than disappearing from the map.
negative_cases: A filename, URL or an uncommitted live worker directory alone cannot identify the documentation baseline.
Silently treating post-DP1 documentation as DP1 truth, overwriting another worker's files or guessing the documentation framework is refused.
Missing documentation input cannot block unrelated implementation work already ready under the DAG.
checks: TO CREATE/USE AFTER BASE.2: python -B tools/preview-transition/check.py --transition docs/releases/developer-preview-1-to-2/transition.json --mode documentation --stage intake --format json
Run only the exact read-only inventory/build discovery commands supplied by the accepted documentation intake; record them before invocation.
acceptance: Exact documentation source/current captures, topic/page/generated-source inventory and bounded future write authority are retained.
NEXT-PREVIEW-DOCS-INPUT is satisfied by actual supplied facts; absent facts remain a specific blocker, not an invented format choice.
tasks.safe_stop: Stop after intake and map creation; do not apply DP2 documentation edits before the root-bound final implementation frontier.

tasks.title: Apply the accepted product delta to documentation
tasks.goal: Update existing and missing documentation topics from the net product changes while preserving concurrent authored work.
steps: After all 17 required milestone outcomes and the bound documentation intake, capture the actual DP2 product candidate and current documentation sources. Compute the change-to-topic delta from permanent accepted impact records and reconcile added/removed/renamed capabilities with the current inventories.

For each mapped topic perform a three-way comparison of the retained documentation base, current worker-authored documentation and the intended product delta. Preserve independent edits, show genuine overlap conflicts and resolve only within the bound authority; do not replace the entire tree with generated prose.

Update commands, defaults, formats, configuration, installation/HOME/Docker workflows, boot and machine interfaces according to their actual delivered semantics. Add missing topics, remove or redirect obsolete topics and preserve explicit unsupported or pending platform qualifications.

Modify authored sources for generated documentation, then run their actual bound generation/build commands. Keep human editorial content outside reproducible generated sections; update documentation-map entries with exact changed sources, retained topic IDs and associated change/capability evidence.

Re-read the resulting user journeys against implemented commands and permanent contracts. Retain unresolved product/documentation discrepancies as blockers instead of marking a topic updated because its file changed.
positive_cases: A concurrent clarification survives while the same page receives a product-driven command update.
A new installation or machine-interface capability receives a new topic and navigation links.
Generated reference pages are reproducible from their changed authoritative source.
negative_cases: Blind overwrite, framework guessing, updating only pre-existing pages or editing generated output by hand is refused.
A task marked implemented cannot justify documenting behavior absent from the actual candidate.
An unresolved three-way conflict or unmapped product claim prevents completion of its topic.
checks: TO CREATE/USE AFTER BASE.2: python -B tools/preview-transition/check.py --transition docs/releases/developer-preview-1-to-2/transition.json --mode documentation --stage updated --format json
Run the exact generation, documentation build and changed-topic checks bound by DOCS.1; report actual exit status and subject captures.
acceptance: Every changed or new topic has a reviewed disposition backed by current product evidence, and all independent incoming documentation edits are preserved.
The update is a concrete reviewable documentation diff with exact source provenance; unresolved topics remain explicit.
tasks.safe_stop: Stop with the documentation delta reviewable; DOCS.3 validates the resulting claims and workflows.

tasks.title: Verify updated documentation against the exact candidate
tasks.goal: Prove the revised documentation describes executable behavior and honest platform limits.
steps: Bind the exact product candidate, documentation commit/tree, generated-source captures and toolchain that the validation will cover. Use documentation-map to enumerate all pages/claims/examples affected by actual changes plus newly introduced topics.

Run the bound documentation build, internal links, generated-output consistency and example checks. Execute affected command workflows in isolated fixtures covering fresh installation and existing authored projects, with representative HOME/Docker and client/machine examples when applicable to their documented claims.

Test default changes, unsupported targets, invalid inputs and expected failures alongside successful paths. Mark unexecuted platform cases unavailable and narrow claims accordingly; a Windows or Docker result is not native coverage of every target.

Reconcile each claimed automatic/manual/rebuild action with its actual implementation and source-preservation behavior. Record exact evidence references and results in documentation-map, repairing authored documentation within its bound perimeter.

Compare the final map to the product capability/topic denominator so that new pages, deleted claims and no-impact conclusions are all accounted. Any product change needed to fix an example returns to root as an accounted implementation repair and invalidates only affected evidence.
positive_cases: Fresh-install and existing-project examples match the same candidate documented by the pages.
A platform limitation appears in both the user guidance and machine evidence.
Changing a command or generated schema invalidates the affected page/example evidence.
negative_cases: A successful doc build alone cannot certify runtime claims.
Skipped commands, zero selected tests, stale candidate hashes and unsupported behavior labelled passed fail the documentation gate.
A product defect is not silently patched outside this documentation task's perimeter.
checks: TO CREATE/USE AFTER BASE.2: python -B tools/preview-transition/check.py --transition docs/releases/developer-preview-1-to-2/transition.json --mode documentation --stage verified --format json
Run the exact bound documentation build, link/example and applicable isolated workflow commands; record nonzero cases and actual platform coverage.
acceptance: All delivered documentation topics have current build/link/claim evidence or explicit truthful limitations consistent with supported product scope.
documentation-map is mechanically readable and bound to the exact candidate; unresolved required workflows block the release lane.
tasks.safe_stop: Stop after documentation validation; migration guide assembly and rehearsal remain separate release tasks.
